description: Mirror Even's Conversate: tap to start, tap to pause/resume, double-tap to end (stop and summarize). Idle root page double-tap must call shutDownPageContainer(1) (Even QA rule). Taps arrive as textEvent on the capturing text container (CLICK may be normalized to undefined); defer single tap briefly so the OS tap-then-long-press menu gesture doesn't pause. Menu keeps marker/pause/stop/save-audio.
title: Glasses tap controls mirroring Conversate
